# Fixed text-markup evidence for #118 and #119

Generated by the real pinned EmbedPDF engine through the production Document
surface and verified export path, on 2026-10-22. The harness unlocks unverified
tools only for testing. Production admission and native save permissions are unchanged.
See `docs/issue-118-119-text-markup-fixes.md` for provenance and native observations.

- `contents.pdf`: Acrobat input with comment-only edits to both subtypes.
- `colour.pdf`: green colour and 50% opacity, retaining padded Rects.
- `moved.pdf`: subsequent 10pt right / 20pt down geometry edit.
- `opaque.pdf`: subsequent opaque colour edit (the no-ExtGState path).
- `selection.pdf`: actual selection of page 3's `sun` and immediate Underline.
- `fonts.pdf`: actual multiline selection across three fonts and sizes.
- `active.pdf`: pointer drags with active Underline, Strikethrough and Highlight.

The Acrobat-derived outputs retain decoded page contents. Comment-only appearance
programs are byte-identical; BBox/Matrix match within PDF float serialization.
Visual edits use a BBox equal to Rect, with identity mapping.
